**Stable ID:** `DATA-01.05` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 01 Scope, taxonomy and governance

Audit what existing T5 training-dataset (#32), T6 evaluation (#36) and other research already owns, so this repository extends rather than duplicates it.

## Deliverables

- Ownership map of existing dataset and evaluation research by repository, path and commit
- List of non-duplicative gaps for this repository

## Canonical artifact paths

- `research/EXISTING_RESEARCH.md`
- `planning/coverage-matrix.json`

## Source and evidence requirements

- Every cited upstream finding references a repository, path and exact commit

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every overlapping topic names its existing owner and the boundary of this repository
- [ ] No upstream finding is restated as new research
- [ ] Research #32 and #36 owners are notified of the boundary

## Non-goals

- Reopening or editing accepted upstream research

## Tasks and subtasks

- [ ] `DATA-01.05.T1` Inventory upstream research
  - [ ] `DATA-01.05.T1.S1` List T5 dataset research files and decisions
  - [ ] `DATA-01.05.T1.S2` List T6 evaluation research files and decisions
  - [ ] `DATA-01.05.T1.S3` List dataset references in applications and papers plans
- [ ] `DATA-01.05.T2` Map boundaries
  - [ ] `DATA-01.05.T2.S1` Record the owner of each topic
  - [ ] `DATA-01.05.T2.S2` Identify gaps that belong here
  - [ ] `DATA-01.05.T2.S3` Record pinned evidence pointers
- [ ] `DATA-01.05.T3` Confirm with owners
  - [ ] `DATA-01.05.T3.S1` Post the boundary summary on the owning issues
  - [ ] `DATA-01.05.T3.S2` Record the responses in the decision register

## Dependencies

- No prerequisite work packages.
- Blocks `DATA-10.01`

- Research lead maintainer
- Owner of research #32 and #36
